description: Net Zero by 2050 Scenario is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by IEA (International Energy Agency (IEA)). The database is subject to the IEA’s Terms and Conditions, available at The Net Zero by 2050 dataset includes figures and tables from the publication along with projections at global level for the Net Zero Emissions by 2050 Scenario (NZE) based on detailed modelling of the energy sector. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 5 files in XLS. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
